result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks but no buffer from the roadway. Parked vehicles on one side create visual obstructions, and the lack of marked crossings at the visible intersection reduces pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right side of the street block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross safely.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at the intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters where space permits to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking any dedicated sidewalk or physical separation from vehicle traffic. Pedestrians are forced to walk on a paved apron that serves as a driveway and parking area, creating significant conflict points with vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or curb, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on a vehicle apron.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire foreground and midground along the building frontage

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The parked car on the left obscures sightlines between pedestrians and vehicles approaching from that direction.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a raised, paved sidewalk to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter
interventions.description: Install a vertical curb to physically separate the pedestrian realm from the vehicle travel and parking lanes.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the garage entrance to improve visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though the left walkway is significantly obstructed by a parked vehicle. While the narrow roadway width likely encourages lower vehicle speeds, the lack of marked crossings and the sidewalk obstruction create potential conflicts for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A white sports car is parked on the left sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street

interventions.title: Sidewalk Protection
interventions.description: Install bollards or other physical barriers to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk and ensure pedestrian clear zones.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles while also providing shade and traffic calming.

result.summary: The image shows a continuous paved sidewalk directly adjacent to a residential building frontage. While the walkway is in good condition, there is no buffer between the pedestrian path and the roadway, and a traffic cone currently obstructs the clear walking width.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A traffic cone is placed in the middle of the sidewalk, creating a tripping hazard and narrowing the clear path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway, placing pedestrians in close proximity to moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of the sidewalk adjacent to the street

interventions.title: Install Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Adding a line of street trees or planters would create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway, improving safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Maintain Clear Path
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk remains free of temporary obstructions like traffic cones to maintain a continuous, accessible route.
